package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/util"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// This deliberately records the actual unscoped fast path (which ignores q)
// separately from a complete typed union over actual engine-selected parent IDs.
// It does not claim upstream filtered-unscoped behavior is faithful.
func TestPulseFilteredUnscoped(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("PULSE_FIXTURE_ROOT")
	if root == "" {
		t.Fatal("PULSE_FIXTURE_ROOT required")
	}
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-filtered-unscoped"
	if e := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	wire, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "test/fixtures/traces/tempo-more-discovery-input.protobuf"))
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	all := &tempopb.Trace{}
	if e = proto.Unmarshal(wire, all); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	var rows []*Trace
	for i, r := range all.ResourceSpans {
		ss := r.ScopeSpans[0]
		sp := ss.Spans[0]
		r.Resource.Attributes = append(r.Resource.Attributes, value("mixed", "1.0"))
		sp.Attributes = append(sp.Attributes, &cv.KeyValue{Key: "mixed", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_IntValue{IntValue: (1 << 60) + int64(i)}}})
		if ss.Scope != nil {
			mixed := &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_BoolValue{BoolValue: i%2 == 0}}
			if i%3 == 0 {
				mixed = &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_DoubleValue{DoubleValue: 1}}
			}
			ss.Scope.Attributes = append(ss.Scope.Attributes, &cv.KeyValue{Key: "mixed", Value: mixed}, value("scope_only", "scope"))
		}
		for _, event := range sp.Events {
			event.Attributes = append(event.Attributes, value("mixed", "excluded-event"))
		}
		for _, link := range sp.Links {
			link.Attributes = append(link.Attributes, value("mixed", "excluded-link"))
		}
		if i%2 == 1 {
			nested := &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_StringValue{StringValue: "nested"}}
			array := &cv.ArrayValue{Values: []*cv.AnyValue{nested}}
			attr := &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_ArrayValue{ArrayValue: array}}
			sp.Attributes = append(sp.Attributes, &cv.KeyValue{Key: "unsupported", Value: attr})
		}
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, sp.TraceId, &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{r}}, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	wire, e = proto.Marshal(all)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(dir+"/input.protobuf", wire, 0644); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	opts := common.DefaultSearchOptions()
	engine := traceql.NewEngine()
	cases := []map[string]any{}
	consumed := 0
	for _, key := range []string{"value", "mixed", "shared", "scope_only", "absent", "unsupported"} {
		for _, q := range []string{`{resource.service.name="worker"}`, `{resource.service.name="frontend"}`, `{resource.service.name="absent"}`, `{resource.service.name=~"work.*"}`, `{span.shared=~"spa.*"}`, `{resource.service.name="worker" && span.shared=~"spa.*"}`} {
			tag, e := traceql.ParseIdentifier("." + key)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			rawSet := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
			collect := traceql.MakeCollectTagValueFunc(func(v tempopb.TagValue) bool { rawSet[v] = true; return false })
			fetch := traceql.NewTagValuesFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchTagValuesRequest, cb traceql.FetchTagValuesCallback) error {
				return block.FetchTagValues(ctx, r, cb, func(uint64) {}, opts)
			})
			rawErr := engine.ExecuteTagValues(context.Background(), tag, q, collect, fetch)
			found, e := engine.ExecuteSearch(context.Background(), &tempopb.SearchRequest{Query: q + " with (most_recent=true)", Limit: 1000, SpansPerSpanSet: 1000}, traceql.NewSpansetFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchSpansRequest) (traceql.FetchSpansResponse, error) {
				return block.Fetch(ctx, r, opts)
			}))
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			ids := map[string]bool{}
			for _, tr := range found.Traces {
				if tr.SpanSet.Matched != uint32(len(tr.SpanSet.Spans)) {
					t.Fatal("clipped fixture")
				}
				for _, sp := range tr.SpanSet.Spans {
					ids[tr.TraceID+"/"+sp.SpanID] = true
				}
			}
			completeSet := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
			unsupported := false
			for _, r := range all.ResourceSpans {
				for _, ss := range r.ScopeSpans {
					for _, sp := range ss.Spans {
						if !ids[util.TraceIDToHexString(sp.TraceId)+"/"+util.SpanIDToHexString(sp.SpanId)] {
							continue
						}
						owners := [][]*cv.KeyValue{r.Resource.Attributes, sp.Attributes}
						if ss.Scope != nil {
							owners = append(owners, ss.Scope.Attributes)
						}
						for _, attrs := range owners {
							for _, attr := range attrs {
								if attr.Key != key {
									continue
								}
								v, ok := pulseOriginalTag(attr.Value)
								if !ok {
									unsupported = true
								} else {
									completeSet[v] = true
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			raw := pulseSortedTags(rawSet)
			complete := pulseSortedTags(completeSet)
			c := map[string]any{"key": key, "query": q, "selected_parents": len(ids), "raw": map[string]any{"tagValues": raw}, "complete": map[string]any{"tagValues": complete}}
			if rawErr != nil {
				c["raw_error"] = rawErr.Error()
			}
			if unsupported {
				c["expected_error"] = "unsupported_trace_tag_type"
			}
			cases = append(cases, c)
			if !unsupported {
				for _, version := range []int{1, 2} {
					file := fmt.Sprintf("%s/result-v%d-%02d.protobuf", dir, version, len(cases)-1)
					data, e := os.ReadFile(file)
					if os.IsNotExist(e) && os.Getenv("PULSE_REQUIRE_CONSUMER") == "" {
						continue
					}
					if e != nil {
						t.Fatal(e)
					}
					if version == 2 {
						got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
						if e = proto.Unmarshal(data, got); e != nil {
							t.Fatal(e)
						}
						if !proto.Equal(got, &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{TagValues: complete}) {
							t.Fatalf("v2 mismatch case %d", len(cases)-1)
						}
					} else {
						set := map[string]bool{}
						for _, v := range complete {
							set[v.Value] = true
						}
						values := []string{}
						for v := range set {
							values = append(values, v)
						}
						sort.Strings(values)
						got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesResponse{}
						if e = proto.Unmarshal(data, got); e != nil {
							t.Fatal(e)
						}
						if strings.Join(got.TagValues, "\x00") != strings.Join(values, "\x00") {
							t.Fatalf("v1 mismatch case %d", len(cases)-1)
						}
					}
					consumed++
				}
			}
		}
	}
	data, e := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(dir+"/oracle.json", append(data, '\n'), 0644); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	t.Logf("%d actual engine-selected-parent cases, %d public decoder messages", len(cases), consumed)
}
func pulseOriginalTag(v *cv.AnyValue) (tempopb.TagValue, bool) {
	switch x := v.Value.(type) {
	case *cv.AnyValue_StringValue:
		return tempopb.TagValue{Type: "string", Value: x.StringValue}, true
	case *cv.AnyValue_IntValue:
		return tempopb.TagValue{Type: "int", Value: strconv.FormatInt(x.IntValue, 10)}, true
	case *cv.AnyValue_BoolValue:
		return tempopb.TagValue{Type: "bool", Value: strconv.FormatBool(x.BoolValue)}, true
	case *cv.AnyValue_DoubleValue:
		return tempopb.TagValue{Type: "float", Value: traceql.NewStaticFloat(x.DoubleValue).EncodeToString(false)}, true
	default:
		return tempopb.TagValue{}, false
	}
}
func pulseSortedTags(set map[tempopb.TagValue]bool) []*tempopb.TagValue {
	result := []*tempopb.TagValue{}
	for v := range set {
		v := v
		result = append(result, &v)
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool {
		if result[i].Type == result[j].Type {
			return result[i].Value < result[j].Value
		}
		return result[i].Type < result[j].Type
	})
	return result
}
